other_conditions: Applicant must not have availed any such subsidy earlier
Applicant must have a bonafide Himachali certificate of the couple
Applicant must possess a valid Scheduled Caste/Other Backward Classes/Minority Community/Single Women or Handicapped certificate
Applicant must provide income and revenue papers (Record of Right – Parcha & Tatima)
Applicant must obtain a recommendation from the concerned Gram Panchayat
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of Rs. 1,30,000 for the construction of a house to eligible marginalized sections.
documents_required: Bonafied Himachali Certificate of the couple
Scheduled Caste/Other Backward Classes/Minority Community/Single Women or Handicapped Certificate
Revenue Papers (Record of Right – Parcha & Tatima)
Recommendation from the concerned Gram Panchayat
Certificate stating that the applicant has not availed any such subsidy earlier
Latest photographs of the present house
